name: Abtech ZP enclosure
summary: Polycarbonate or ABS enclosure family with opaque and clear-lid options.
description: ZP boxes can house terminals or visible instrumentation. For a clear-lid arrangement, keep the instrument viewing area aligned with the lid and accessible to an operator.
Use the linked manufacturer CAD for dimensions and the exact selected configuration. The downloadable illustration here is original educational geometry, unitless and not to scale.
readingNotes: Specify base material and lid choice in the equipment schedule; a shared outline alone does not identify them.
A transparent cover permits viewing but does not make the enclosed controls externally operable.
